messages:
zara: hey team, quick onboarding hiccup  opened my first PR but the Buildkite job never starts and GitHub shows a required check missing so i can't merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood/example/pull/523
kai: welcome @zara! what does the Buildkite step show in the PR UI? sometimes agents are full or tagged pools don't match.
zara: PR UI shows 'Queued' and the buildkite link shows: 
```
Waiting for an available agent in pool: ci-us-spot
No eligible agents matched constraint: tag:linux && tag:docker && capacity:>=2
```
zara: i've never seen that message before.
infra-oncall: hey @zara  that message means the pipeline requested a runner with specific tags and a minimum capacity, but none of the registered agents meet that filter currently. Did you use the default pipeline or a workspace-specific variant?
zara: i used the default redwood-ci/main pipeline via the PR. i didn't change any tags.
jen: we recently added a capacity check to prevent small agents from taking large matrix jobs. new hires might hit this if pools are temporarily down. @infra-oncall can you check agent pool health?
buildkite-bot: buildkite pipeline "redwood-ci/main" queued for PR #523 (job id: bk-52399).
infra-oncall: looking now  pool ci-us-spot has 0 available agents (maintenance window) and the fallback pool ci-us-standard has agents but they lack the "capacity:>=2" tag. i'll relax the capacity constraint for this pipeline for hotfixes and requeue.
kai: for onboarding, we usually recommend using the smaller runner profile (ci-us-standard) to avoid needing high-capacity tags unless you're running heavy matrix builds. zara, does your job need capacity>=2?
zara: the pipeline matrix defaults to 2 containers for parallel lint/test but i'm happy to run single-container for my first PR. how do i change that?
jen: you can add env CI_PARALLEL=1 in the pipeline vars or push a tiny commit that sets the matrix to 1. infra can also temporary relax the pipeline constraint which is faster.
infra-oncall: relaxed the capacity constraint for pipeline redwood-ci/main on repo example. requeued job to ci-us-standard. should start now.
buildkite-bot: buildkite pipeline "redwood-ci/main" started for PR #523 (job id: bk-52400).
zara: it's running on ci-us-standard now, thanks!
buildkite-bot: pipeline bk-52400 finished for PR #523  passed ✅
status-bot: GitHub status updated: all checks passed.
jen: welcome @zara :tada: quick notes for onboarding doc: 1) we added capacity constraints recently, 2) if you see "No eligible agents" include the agent pool name and the job id in your ping, 3) small matrix changes (CI_PARALLEL=1) can be a quick workaround.
zara: merged, thanks everyone! excited to be here :tada:
